arxiv-1503-04374.title: Science Bots: a Model for the Future of Scientific Computation? Conference: WWW 2015 Companion, May 18–22, 2015, Florence, Italy.
arxiv-1503-04374.creator: Tobias Kuhn
arxiv-1503-04374.description: Abstract As a response to the trends of the increasing importance of computational approaches and the accelerating pace in science, I propose in this position paper to establish the concept of “science bots” that autonomously perform programmed tasks on input data they encounter and immediately publish the results.

arxiv-1801-07017.title: The magnetic variability of the β \beta Cep star ξ 1 \xi^{1} CMa Journal: New Astronomy
arxiv-1801-07017.creator: S. P. Järvinen, S. Hubrig, M. Schöller, I. Ilyin
arxiv-1801-07017.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by S. P. Järvinen, S. Hubrig, M. Schöller, I. Ilyin. ξ 1 \xi^{1} CMa is a known magnetic star showing rotationally modulated magnetic variability with a period of 2.17937 d. However, recent work based on high-resolution spectropolarimetry suggests that the rotation period is longer than 30 years. We compare our new spectropolarimetric measurements with FORS 2 at the VLT acquired on three consecutive nights in 2017 to previous FORS 1/2 measurements of the longitudinal magnetic field strength.

arxiv-2308-03924.title: First application of a liquid argon time projection chamber for the search for intranuclear neutron-antineutron transitions and annihilation in 40 Ar using the MicroBooNE detector
arxiv-2308-03924.creator: C. Zhang
arxiv-2308-03924.description: Abstract We present a novel methodology to search for intranuclear neutron-antineutron transition ( n → n ¯ n\rightarrow\bar{n} ) followed by n ¯ \bar{n} -nucleon annihilation within an 40 Ar nucleus, using the MicroBooNE liquid argon time projection chamber (LArTPC) detector.

arxiv-2404-05811.title: Systematic Biases in Estimating the Properties of Black Holes Due to Inaccurate Gravitational-Wave Models
arxiv-2404-05811.creator: Arnab Dhani, Sebastian H. Völkel, Alessandra Buonanno, Hector Estelles, Jonathan Gair, Harald P. Pfeiffer, Lorenzo Pompili, Alexandre Toubiana
arxiv-2404-05811.description: Abstract Gravitational-wave (GW) observations of binary black-hole (BBH) coalescences are expected to address outstanding questions in astrophysics, cosmology, and fundamental physics. Inference of BBH parameters relies on waveform models, and realizing the full discovery potential of upcoming LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing runs and new ground-based facilities (such as the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer) hinges on the accuracy of these waveform models.

arxiv-2411-00946.title: Classical versus quantum queries in quantum PCPs with classical proofs
arxiv-2411-00946.creator: Harry Buhrman, François Le Gall, Jordi Weggemans
arxiv-2411-00946.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Harry Buhrman, François Le Gall, Jordi Weggemans. We generalize quantum-classical PCPs, first introduced by Weggemans, Folkertsma and Cade (TQC 2024), to allow for q q quantum queries to a polynomially-sized classical proof ( 𝖰𝖢𝖯𝖢𝖯 Q , c , s ​ [ q ] \mathsf{QCPCP}_{Q,c,s}[q] ).

arxiv-2502-04709.title: Early Stopping for Regression Trees
arxiv-2502-04709.creator: Ratmir Miftachov, Markus Reiß
arxiv-2502-04709.description: Abstract We develop early stopping rules for growing regression tree estimators. The fully data-driven stopping rule is based on monitoring the global residual norm. The best-first search and the breadth-first search algorithms together with linear interpolation give rise to generalized projection or regularization flows. A general theory of early stopping is established.

arxiv-2506-20220.title: High resolution ALMA observations of H 2 S in LIRGS
arxiv-2506-20220.creator: M. T.Sato, S. Aalto, S. König, K. Kohno, S. Viti, M. Gorski, F. Combes, S. García-Burillo, N. Harada, P. van der Werf, J. Otter, S. Muller, Y. Nishimura, J. S. Gallagher, A. S. Evans, K. M. Dasyra, J. K. Kotilainen
arxiv-2506-20220.description: Abstract Context. Molecular gas plays a critical role in regulating star formation and nuclear activity in galaxies. Sulphur-bearing molecules, such as H 2 S, are sensitive to the physical and chemical environments in which they reside and are potential tracers of shocked, dense gas in galactic outflows and active galactic nuclei (AGN). Aims.

arxiv-2510-04425.title: Bin Packing and Covering: Pushing the Frontier on the Maximin Share Fairness
arxiv-2510-04425.creator: Bo Li, Ankang Sun, Zunyu Wang, Yu Zhou
arxiv-2510-04425.description: Abstract We study a fundamental fair allocation problem, where the agent’s value is determined by the number of bins either used to pack or cover the items allocated to them. Fairness is evaluated using the maximin share (MMS) criterion. This problem is not only motivated by practical applications, but also serves as a natural framework for studying group fairness.

arxiv-2510-23695.title: New Bounds on Heavy QCD Axions from Big Bang Nucleosynthesis
arxiv-2510-23695.creator: Tae Hyun Jung, Takemichi Okui, Kohsaku Tobioka, Jiabao Wang
arxiv-2510-23695.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tae Hyun Jung, Takemichi Okui, Kohsaku Tobioka, Jiabao Wang. We study Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) constraints on heavy QCD axions. BBN offers a powerful probe of new physics that modifies the neutron-to-proton ratio during the process, thanks to the precisely measured primordial Helium-4 abundance. A heavy QCD axion provides an attractive target for this probe, because not only is it a well-motivated hypothetical particle by the strong CP problem, but also it dominantly decays to hadrons if kinematically allowed.

pmc-10744798.title: The Identity, Virulence, and Antifungal Effects of the Didymellacesous Fungi Associated with the Rapeseed Blackleg Pathogen Leptosphaeria biglobosa
pmc-10744798.creator: Junyu Cheng, Tao Luo, Mingde Wu, Long Yang, Weidong Chen, Guoqing Li, Jing Zhang, Katrina Maria Ramonell
pmc-10744798.description: Eight fungal strains (P1 to P8) were isolated from rapeseed stems (Brassica napus) infected with the blackleg pathogen Leptosphaeria biglobosa (Lb). They formed pycnidia with similar morphology to those of Lb, and thus were considered as Lb relatives (LbRs). The species-level identification of these strains was performed.

pmc-11314462.creator: Ecem Bolat, Sümeyye Sarıtaş, Hatice Duman, Furkan Eker, Emir Akdaşçi, Sercan Karav, Anna Maria Witkowska, Joanna Bartkowiak-Wieczorek, Edyta Mądry

Characterized by multiple varieties, polyphenols are mostly found in fruits and vegetables. Currently, many diseases are waiting for a cure or a solution to reduce their symptoms.

pmc-11491983.title: Resorption characteristics of an open architecture biocomposite interference screw after ACL reconstruction
pmc-11491983.creator: Martin Lind, Torsten Grønbech Nielsen, Flemming K Nielsen, Ole G Sørensen, Bjarne Mygind‐Klavsen, Peter Faunø
pmc-11491983.description: PurposeAbsorbable interference screws for anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) can lead to tunnel widening and cyst formation. The Biosure Regenesorb interference screw (Smith & Nephew). has been developed with an optimised calcium phosphate/polymer composition to promote bone formation during resorption.

pmc-12426209.title: 3D nanoprinting of embryo microinjection needles with anti-clogging features
pmc-12426209.creator: Sunandita Sarker, Ziteng Wen, Ruben Acevedo, Andrew C Lamont, Adira Colton, Lucas Kieran Muller, DoHwan Park, Eleonora Tubaldi, Kinneret Rand-Yadin, Ryan D Sochol
pmc-12426209.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Wide-ranging biomedical applications spanning both research and clinical settings rely on microinjection protocols that involve using a long, hollow microneedle to deliver foreign substances directly into biological targets, such as embryos. Unfortunately, conventional microneedles are prone to clogging—e.g., cytoplasmic material from an embryo becoming lodged inside the needle tip during penetration, thereby obstructing delivery—motivating researchers to use top-down microfabrication techniques to modify needle tips and reduce such failure modes.

pmc-12445431.title: Efficacy of Topical Non-Selective and COX-2 Selective NSAIDs in Accelerating Resolution of Acute Central Serous Chorioretinopathy: A Retrospective Analysis
pmc-12445431.creator: Preston O’Brien, Michael A Singer, Darren J Bell, Abigail Diamond, Allison Kim, Ella H Leung, David S Chin Yee, Rishi P Singh, Andrew N Antoszyk
pmc-12445431.description: PurposeTo evaluate whether topical nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) accelerate the resolution of acute central serous chorioretinopathy (CSCR) compared with observation.Patients and methodsThis retrospective cohort study reviewed patients diagnosed with acute CSCR (2018–2023) (n = 145). Patients received either topical ketorolac (n = 26, nonselective NSAID, four times daily) or observation alone (n = 63).

pmc-12587023.title: Cyclopenta‐Fused Polyaromatic Hydrocarbon (CP‐PAH) Radicals: Synthesis, Characterization, and Quantum Chemical Calculations
pmc-12587023.creator: Ali S. Acan, Jonas O. Wenzel, Joachim Podlech
pmc-12587023.description: Two air‐ and moisture‐stable cyclopenta‐fused polyaromatic hydrocarbon (CP‐PAH) radicals with six six‐ and three five‐membered rings alternately fused to nonacycles were obtained by ortho fusion in suitably ortho,ortho’‐substituted dinaphthylfluorenes and subsequent establishment of the conjugation. The radicals were obtained in five consecutive steps with total yields of 38 and 16%, respectively; key steps are Suzuki couplings and cyclizing SEAr reactions.

pmc-12852677.title: Comparative efficacy of pulmonary rehabilitation delivery models on dyspnoea, exercise capacity and health-related quality of life in chronic respiratory disease: a systematic review and network meta-analysis
pmc-12852677.creator: Jia Song, Qin Wang, Chongyang Zhao, Lei Wang, Li Li, Deying Kang
pmc-12852677.description: This systematic review aimed to systematise the different models used to deliver pulmonary rehabilitation (PR) during chronic respiratory diseases (CRDs) and explore which ones are the most effective in terms of dyspnea, exercise capacity, and health-related quality of life (HRQoL).

pmc-13098102.title: Pathological and Epidemiological Assessment of Trematode Burden in Ruminants From Central Ethiopia
pmc-13098102.creator: Adisu Wakuma Boke, Yacob Hailu Tolosa, Abdi Feyisa Fufa, Jirata Shiferaw Abosse
pmc-13098102.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundTrematode infections in ruminants cause major economic losses through reduced productivity and liver condemnation, with their epidemiology closely linked to snail habitats, rainfall patterns, and poor grazing management. A cross‐sectional study was conducted from November 2022 to March 2023 to characterize pathological changes caused by trematode infections and identify associated risk factors in ruminants slaughtered at three selected abattoirs in central Ethiopia.MethodsA total of 256 ruminants, 137 bovine, 64 ovine and 55 caprine were included in the study.

pmc-13240453.title: Intestinal Parasitic Infections in Marginalized Populations: Prevalence and Risk Factors Among the Bantar Community of Sunsari, Nepal
pmc-13240453.creator: Mukesh Kumar Mahato, Jitendra Gautam, Niten Bharati, Darwin Niroula, Krishna Prasad Acharya, Tulsi Ram Gompo, Kishor Pandey
pmc-13240453.description: BackgroundNepal continues to exhibit a high burden of intestinal parasite infections (IPIs). This study aimed to determine the prevalence and associated risk factors of IPIs among the indigenous Bantar community in Koshi Rural Municipality, Sunsari, Nepal.MethodsA total of 180 individuals aged 10–70 years were selected through convenience sampling. Stool samples were preserved in 2.5% potassium dichromate solution.

pmc-13414182.creator: Mayur B. Patil, Sushant Sukumar Patil, Payal A. Mahadule, Amol R. Pawar, Komal Anil Gade, Thangasamy Arunachalam

pmc-13432757.title: A Rare Case of Cutaneous Extramedullary Hematopoiesis in Chronic Myeloid Leukemia
pmc-13432757.creator: Bennett Christie‐Nguyen, Hanadi El Achi, Levani Iashvili, Amer Wahed, Brenda Mai, Jacob Armstrong
pmc-13432757.description: Cutaneous extramedullary hematopoiesis (CEH) is a rare manifestation of extramedullary hematopoiesis (EMH), a process typically associated with fetal development or myeloproliferative neoplasms. EMH most commonly involves the spleen, liver, and lymph nodes, with CEH being exceedingly rare in chronic myeloid leukemia (CML).
